run_evaluate_all: run evaluate_all to evaluate box detection, segmentation, keypoints, and body UV on a dataset
run_evaluate_boxes: run evaluate_boxes to evaluate bounding box detection results for a COCO, Cityscapes, or VOC dataset
run_evaluate_masks: run evaluate_masks to evaluate instance segmentation results for a COCO or Cityscapes dataset
run_evaluate_keypoints: run evaluate_keypoints to evaluate human keypoint detection results for a COCO keypoints dataset
run_evaluate_body_uv: run evaluate_body_uv to evaluate dense pose body UV estimation results for a dataset
